programme.desc: Faced with Ezequiel's intentions, Octavia and Marcelina verbally attack Camila. Max proposes and Camila hesitates but agrees to marry him. At a dinner party, Ezequiel gathers his children and Camila will be the special guest of honor.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: At the dinner, the main topic will be Rosa Blanco. Ezequiel says that this woman was an opportunist who fell in love with and took advantage of his younger brother, Leoncio. programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Mother Isabel defends Camila from Roberto's accusation and confronts Camila. Max, finding her very sad, asks her to trust him. Julia and Gregorio come up with a plan to make their parents think they will never see each other again and stop following them.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila fiercely defends herself from Roberto's aggression and tells Max what happened. Mother Isabel, to help Camila, confides to Ezequiel why Roberto is extorting her. Max pressures Camila to tell him the whole truth.
